- about: reset_values
  text: The RTL resets COUNTER, BRIGHTNESS, CONTROL and the press counts to zero, so the display is enabled and brightness
    is 0 (LEDs dark) after reset; this matches the spec.yaml register map. An interview answer in spec.yaml says DUTY resets
    to 0x40 and CTRL to 0x2; the RTL (rtl/t1_led_dimmer_counter.sv) does not do that.
- about: pwm_rate
  text: An interview answer in spec.yaml gives a 1024-cycle PWM period (about 97.7 kHz). The RTL advances the phase every
    clock, so the period is 256 cycles, about 390.625 kHz, as in the spec timing section.
- about: uart_pins
  text: ARCHITECTURE.md lists uart_rx on D4 and uart_tx on C4. design.xdc and spec.yaml put uart_rx on C4 and uart_tx on
    D4; the XDC is what was built.
- about: unmapped_access
  text: Reads of unmapped window offsets return 0. Writes to unmapped or read-only offsets (DESIGN_ID, BUTTON_STATE, SWITCH_STATE
    and the three press counts) change nothing, yet the shell still answers with OK status because the window has no error
    path. The shell treats addresses below 0x80 as its own registers.
- about: control_bits
  text: CONTROL stores and reads back all 32 written bits, including the reserved ones; only bit 0 (switch brightness) and
    bit 1 (blank display) have an effect.
- about: counter_priority
  text: A button event is one pulse per debounced rising edge; holding does not repeat. Centre clear beats up and down;
    simultaneous up and down cancel. A UART write to COUNTER in the same cycle beats any button action on the counter, though
    the press counts still increment. The press counts wrap at 32 bits and the counter at 16 bits.
- about: brightness_source
  text: In switch mode the switches set the active brightness and the display shows it. The stored BRIGHTNESS register is
    not overwritten, remains writable and readable, and is used again when CONTROL bit 0 is cleared. Brightness 255 forces
    the LEDs fully on; 0 gives none.
- about: latency_count
  text: 'Counted from the RTL: LEDs, segments, digit enables and the register read data each add one registered stage. Button
    events need two synchroniser flops plus DEBOUNCE_CYCLES minus one stable cycles before the pulse, and release is debounced
    the same way. A full display frame is 8 times DISPLAY_SCAN_CYCLES clocks, as the spec says.'
- about: switch_sync
  text: Switches pass through a single register stage (switches_sync) in rtl/t1_led_dimmer_counter.sv, not a two-flop synchroniser,
    although the spec text says buttons and switches are synchronised. design.xdc treats them as a false path. The shared
    sync2.sv is used only by the UART receiver.
- about: display_glyphs
  text: Hex digits B and D are drawn as the lowercase shapes (segment codes 7C and 5E); other letters are uppercase. AN4
    and AN5 remain enabled but have all segments off.
- about: assumption_reset_bridge
  text: The top builds its own two-flop reset bridge and does not instantiate shell/rtl/reset_sync.sv, which build.yaml
    still lists as a source. The run assumed the two are equivalent.
